title: 第2章 故人来访
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

都说英雄造时势，其实小人物也是可以改变历史走向的。比如：秦始皇手下那个拿药袋砸了荆轲一下的医官夏无且、刺杀孙策的三个许贡门客、在马邑泄露汉军计谋的雁门尉史，特别是钓鱼城下一炮轰死蒙哥的南宋士兵。

项羽的叔父项伯在“楚汉争霸”时期可以说是“反面典型”，他虽为项氏宗族，深受项梁和项羽的信任，然而在刘邦和项羽争夺天下的过程中却多次“胳膊肘往外拐”，甚至不少人将项羽的败亡归罪于项伯。那么，项羽被消灭后，项伯的结局又是如何呢？

项伯本名项缠，出身楚国贵族项氏，史料虽未记载其具体出身，但应该和项梁、项羽血脉关系较近，是项梁的堂兄弟。项梁在秦末起兵后，项伯前往追随，后项梁拥立楚国宗族熊心为楚怀王，项伯被楚怀王任命为左尹。

不过令人称奇的是，虽然他是项羽阵营的主要成员，却在鸿门宴救了刘邦、广武之战救了刘邦的老爹刘太公。作为刘邦的恩人，项伯最后结局如何呢？简单来说就是结局挺好，封侯了，只不过不姓项了，改姓刘了。

项羽乌江自刎后，项伯率项氏宗族投降刘邦，刘邦为了笼络人心，赦免项氏全族并赐姓刘。于是项伯改名刘缠，被封为射阳侯，封地位于今江苏省扬州市宝应县射阳湖镇东部。不过鸿门宴时候答应的儿女亲家的事就免谈了。

项伯还是缠氏的得姓始祖，在项伯的后裔子孙中，有以先祖的名字为姓氏者，称“缠氏”。缠氏族人主要分布在今山西省朔州市、阳泉市平定县太行山区等地，河北省蠡县大曲提乡等地。

前201年，刘邦第三次分封功臣，项伯和张良、萧何等十三人同列，正式受封为侯，但具体食邑数量未见记载。项伯归汉后虽被封侯，但因曾是项羽阵营的核心成员，未获实权，仅以列侯身份享受封地赋税，生活优渥但远离朝政。他在前192年去世，享年70余岁，善终。

话说项羽驻军新丰鸿门，兵力40万，对外号称“百万大军”。刘邦驻军灞上，兵力10万，对外号称“二十万”。一方是磨刀霍霍、杀气腾腾、志在必得，一方则是心惊胆战、手足无措、坐以待毙。如果没有项伯顾及朋友之义，估计此后的中国历史就要改写了。

项羽的叔父项伯跟张良有交情，想当年，项伯出来混江湖时不小心杀了人，从此他踏上了漫漫的逃亡之路。他逃到下邳时，与同样隐身于此的张良相遇，两人一见如故，项伯便在张良的小屋里落了脚。

张良救了项伯一命。滴水之恩，当涌泉相报；救命之恩，当以命相报。张良目前就在刘邦的公司上班，项羽要率军荡平刘邦军营，张良如何能够安然脱困？

想到这里，项伯顿觉热血上涌，他连夜骑马跑到刘邦军营，私下会见了张良，把真相一股脑儿全告诉了他：“项羽明天就要打过来了，赶紧跟我跑路吧！”

面对故友的善意提醒，张良却说：“不！刘邦是我的伯乐，我不能抛弃他。”一转身，张良就把这个消息告诉了刘邦。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It is said that heroes create trends, but in fact, small people can also change the direction of history.For example: Xia Wuji, the medical officer under Qin Shihuang who hit Jing Ke with a medicine bag, the three Xu Gong retainers who assassinated Sun Ce, Yanmen Lieutenant Shi who leaked the Han army's plan in Mayi, especially the Southern Song soldiers who killed Meng Ge with a cannon in Diaoyu City.

Xiang Yu's uncle Xiang Bo can be said to be a "negative example" during the "Chu-Han Struggle for Hegemony". Although he belonged to the Xiang clan and was deeply trusted by Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu, he "turned his elbow outward" many times during the struggle between Liu Bang and Xiang Yu for the world. Many people even blamed Xiang Bo for Xiang Yu's defeat.So, after Xiang Yu was eliminated, what was the ending of Xiang Bo?

Xiang Bo's real name was Xiang Dan, and he was born into the Xiang family, a noble family of the Chu state. Although historical records do not record his specific origin, he should be closely related to Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu, and he was Xiang Liang's cousin.After Xiang Liang raised his army at the end of the Qin Dynasty, Xiang Bo went to follow him. Later Xiang Liang supported Xiong Xin, a clan member of Chu State, as King Chu Huai. Xiang Bo was appointed Zuo Yin by King Chu Huai.

But what is amazing is that although he is a major member of Xiang Yu's camp, he saved Liu Bang at the Hongmen Banquet and Liu Bang's father Liu Taigong at the Battle of Guangwu.As Liu Bang's benefactor, what is the final outcome of Xiang Bo?To put it simply, the ending was pretty good. He was granted the title of Marquis, but his surname was changed to Liu instead of Xiang.

After Xiang Yu committed suicide in Wujiang, Xiang Bo led the Xiang clan to surrender to Liu Bang. In order to win over people's hearts, Liu Bang pardoned the entire Xiang clan and gave them the surname Liu.So Xiang Bo changed his name to Liu Pan and was granted the title of Marquis of Sheyang. The fiefdom was located in the east of Sheyang Lake Town, Baoying County, Yangzhou City, Jiangsu Province today.However, there is no need to talk about the children's and in-laws matters that were promised during the Hongmen Banquet.

Xiang Bo is also the ancestor of the Tang family. Among Xiang Bo's descendants, there are those who take their ancestor's name as their surname, and they are called "Cang family".The people of the Mao clan are mainly distributed in today's Shuozhou City, Shanxi Province, Taihang Mountain District, Pingding County, Yangquan City, and Daquti Township, Li County, Hebei Province.

In 201 BC, Liu Bang divided the meritorious officials for the third time. Xiang Bo, Zhang Liang, Xiao He and other thirteen people were on the same list and were officially granted the title of marquis, but the specific number of fiefdoms was not recorded.Although Xiang Bo was granted the title of marquis after returning to the Han Dynasty, he did not receive real power because he was a core member of Xiang Yu's camp. He only enjoyed the fiefdom and taxes as a marquis, and lived a comfortable life but stayed away from the government.He died in 192 BC at the age of more than 70 years old.

It is said that Xiang Yu garrisoned Xinfeng Hongmen with 400,000 troops, which was known as the "million-strong army".Liu Bang garrisoned Bashang with a strength of 100,000, which was known as "200,000" to the outside world.One side is sharpening its sword, full of murderous intent, and determined to win, while the other side is frightened, at a loss, and waiting to die.If Bo Xiang had not taken care of his friends, it is estimated that the history of China would have been rewritten in the future.

Xiang Yu's uncle, Xiang Bo, had a relationship with Zhang Liang. He recalled that when he went out to wander the world, he accidentally killed someone. From then on, he embarked on a long road to escape.When he fled to Xiapi, he met Zhang Liang, who was also hiding there. The two hit it off, and Xiang Bo settled in Zhang Liang's hut.

Zhang Liang saved Xiang Bo's life.The kindness of a drop of water should be repaid with a spring; the kindness of saving a life should be repaid with a life.Zhang Liang is currently working in Liu Bang's company. Xiang Yu is going to lead his army to destroy Liu Bang's barracks. How can Zhang Liang escape safely?

Thinking of this, Xiang Bo felt his blood surge. He rode overnight to Liu Bang's military camp, met with Zhang Liang privately, and told him all the truth: "Xiang Yu is coming tomorrow, so run away with me!"

Faced with the kind reminder from his old friend, Zhang Liang said: "No! Liu Bang is my Bole, I can't abandon him." As soon as he turned around, Zhang Liang told Liu Bang the news.
